images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: editorial raster illustration for the NEXT ME project brief in a university slide deck.
Primary request: illustrate people inventing useful future services with artificial intelligence in the year 2050.
Scene/backdrop: clean pure white background, an airy human-centered design studio represented with a few geometric shapes.
Subject: two diverse young adult designers collaboratively arranging a tangible adaptive object and a living plant habitat. A small abstract AI co-creation interface links their sketches to three purposeful outcomes: an adaptable everyday object, a miniature ecosystem and a spatial learning environment. People are the protagonists; the technology is a tool.
Style/medium: sophisticated flat geometric editorial illustration, crisp clean edges, minimal details, deliberate confident silhouettes, no perspective-heavy 3D rendering. Flat solid fills and consistent indigo strokes, matching a restrained academic graphic-design booklet.
Composition/framing: one coherent landscape scene, approximately 3:2, centered complete composition, 8 percent white breathing room, readable at 440 pixels wide.
Color palette: strictly deep indigo #432DD7, indigo #615FFF, pale lavender #EEECFF, warm yellow #FDC700 and pure white; tiny dark indigo details. All visible skin tones are stylized pale lavender or warm yellow to keep the restricted editorial palette.
Lighting/mood: optimistic, imaginative, clever and calm.
Text: none.
Constraints: show collaboration and concrete future services, not a generic robot or glowing brain. No lettering, words, logos, watermark, gradients, textures, shadows or photorealism. Do not create a slide, border, frame, collage, grid or multiple panels. White opaque background.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: editorial raster illustration for a NEXT ME university slide explaining how to turn people's needs into a future AI service.
Primary request: a young adult visitor and a designer collaboratively personalize a future learning experience. The visitor chooses tangible geometric pieces; the designer connects those choices to an adaptive learning space, with the AI represented as a small unobtrusive network of connected dots.
Scene/backdrop: pure white, uncluttered editorial space with only a few pale lavender architectural shapes.
Subject: two young adults facing a small shared table, one indicating a choice while the other arranges a personalized experience. A simple indigo doorway opens onto an imaginative learning space containing a plant and a changing geometric object. Emphasize listening, human choices and collaboration.
Style/medium: sophisticated flat geometric editorial illustration, crisp silhouettes, clean consistent indigo line work, a few simple flat solid color planes; coordinated with an academic graphic-design booklet.
Composition/framing: portrait composition around 4:5, full coherent scene centered, complete subjects visible, generous white breathing room around them, clear at 360 pixels wide.
Color palette: strictly deep indigo #432DD7, indigo #615FFF, pale lavender #EEECFF, warm yellow #FDC700 and white. Stylized pale lavender or warm yellow skin. Match the palette of the NEXT ME design-studio illustration.
Mood: attentive, imaginative, optimistic, calm.
Text: none.
Constraints: do not render a slide, frame, collage or multiple panels. No lettering, logos, watermarks, gradients, photographic textures, dramatic light, glowing brains, humanoid robots or sci-fi clutter. White opaque background.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: coordinated editorial raster illustration for the NEXT ME university slide "Dal concept al sito web".
Primary request: show an accessible responsive website connecting an invented future service to the people who use it.
Scene/backdrop: pure white background with generous empty space, an uncluttered geometric editorial composition.
Subject: a large desktop browser window and an overlapping smartphone present the same fictional service coherently. The desktop shows a simple picture of an adaptive geometric everyday object, three clear service choices and a short configuration form with a warm yellow confirmation action. The phone shows the corresponding service detail and confirmation. A young adult visitor points to a choice, showing that people control the process. Use only abstract rectangles, circles and lines for interface text; do not generate readable lettering.
Style/medium: sophisticated flat geometric editorial illustration with crisp silhouettes, clean consistent indigo line work, a few solid color planes; the same visual family as the NEXT ME illustrations of young adults co-designing future services. The devices are illustrated, not screenshots or photorealistic product renders.
Composition/framing: coherent centered landscape scene approximately 3:2, complete devices and person visible, white breathing room, readable at 440 pixels wide. Interfaces remain simple enough to understand at slide scale.
Color palette: strictly deep indigo #432DD7, indigo #615FFF, pale lavender #EEECFF, warm yellow #FDC700 and pure white. Stylized lavender or yellow skin.
Mood: clear, welcoming, optimistic and useful.
Text: none; abstract text bars only.
Constraints: no logos, lettering, numbers, watermark, gradients, textures, shadows, glowing brains, humanoid robots, decorative sci-fi HUDs, collage, panels, slide borders or slide headings. White opaque background.
